title: Office Gossip
synopsis: Little Liu has heard something about two colleagues, and is telling Little Fang all about it.

fullText.simplified:
办公室八卦

小方：哎，你听说了吗？销售部的张明又升职了。
小刘：早就听说了！
小方：他也太厉害了吧？这才来公司多久，就已经升职两次了！长得还那么帅，让人不服都不行。
小刘：嘿嘿，是啊，他非常“厉害”！
小方：怎么感觉你话里有话呀？
小刘：你不知道吗？你可别说是我说的啊，听说他和我们黄总……
小方：黄总？人事部的黄总？
小刘：嘘！小声点！
小方：你这么一说我倒想起来了，开会的时候总看见他和黄总眉来眼去的。
小刘：小声点！
小方：还以为他有多厉害呢，原来是个小白脸啊！
小刘：算了，别人的事我们也管不着！不和你八卦了，我得回去工作了。
小方：好，待会儿见。
fullText.traditional:
辦公室八卦

小方：哎，你聽說了嗎？銷售部的張明又升職了。
小劉：早就聽說了！
小方：他也太厲害了吧？這才來公司多久，就已經升職兩次了！長得還那麼帥，讓人不服都不行。
小劉：嘿嘿，是啊，他非常“厲害”！
小方：怎麼感覺你話裡有話呀？
小劉：你不知道嗎？你可別說是我說的啊，聽說他和我們黃總……
小方：黃總？人事部的黃總？
小劉：噓！小聲點！
小方：你這麼一說我倒想起來了，開會的時候總看見他和黃總眉來眼去的。
小劉：小聲點！
小方：還以為他有多厲害呢，原來是個小白臉啊！
小劉：算了，別人的事我們也管不著！不和你八卦了，我得回去工作了。
小方：好，待會兒見。

raw.synopsis: Little Liu has heard something about two colleagues, and is telling Little Fang all about it.
sentence_translations: Little Fang: Hey, have you heard? Zhang Ming in the sales department has been promoted again.
Little Liu: I heard that long ago!
Little Fang: How is he so awesome?
How long has he been at the company, and already been promoted two times!
To also look that handsome, you have no choice but to just accept it.
Little Liu: Haha, that’s it, he’s extremely “awesome”!
Little Fang: Why does it feel like you’re implying something?
Little Liu: You don’t know? You can’t say that I said so, but I heard that he and our manager Huang…
Little Fang: Manager Huang? The manager Huang at the department of human resources?
Little Liu: Sh! Lower your voice!
Little Fang: When you put it like that I actually remember something.
During meetings, I always saw him and manager Huang make goo-goo eyes at each other.
Little Fang: I thought he was very awesome, and it turns out he’s a pretty boy!
Little Liu: Forget it, other people’s affairs are none of our business!
I won’t gossip with you anymore, I have to get back to work.
Little Fang: Ok, see you in a while.
